content: All creatures, two-legged, four-legged, winged, and rooted, are sacred relatives in the great circle of life.
author: Native American Proverbs
sourceWork: Mitakuye Oyasin (All My Relations) — Lakota Sacred Prayer
explanation: This primordial Lakota prayer is the foundational recognition of cosmic non-duality: we are not superior lords lording over nature, but humble brothers and sisters with the wolf, the cedar, the eagle, and the stone. Walking with this prayer dissolves all lonely isolation.
practicalInsight: Greet the morning sun or a nearby tree with the silent words: 'Mitakuye Oyasin — all my relations.'
reflectionPrompt: How does feeling kinship with all living beings dissolve your feelings of loneliness and alienation?
